node_identity.node_id: integer shared with every label table

schema.value_codec: STRICT ANY columns preserve native string/integer/real storage. Booleans are 0/1; arrays/objects canonical JSON text. Absent properties are SQL NULL; node_property distinguishes stored null from absence. Nested JSON outputs use SQLite JSON functions. Private _ tables are inaccessible.
schema.auxiliary_identity_codec: Join node_identity USING(node_id) to access the same loader-only iri as Neo4j. Source IRI containing RANx is not the loader iri; the latter uses /inst/_/{cls}/{nid}. This is stable entity identity, not a source-authored property. Business identifier fields remain their original values.

preservation_exceptions._node_record: Exactly168 existing objects gain sourceAuthoredClausesAffected; json_remove of only this key reconstructs every original record.
preservation_exceptions.node_property: Exactly168 new string rows; excluding only the new key reconstructs the full original table.
preservation_exceptions.CR,Tdoc: Exactly168 nonnull cells in the additive column each; every original column and row remains byte-value-identical.

limits: Separate source extension, not the frozen snapshot.
The1996 unavailable recorded fields remain unknown; not physical negatives.
Actual new native inventory/property/trace capture, independent full SQL and scorer controls remain required.
No numeric/title alias, status, approval, source CurrentVersion default, or latest edition substitution.
